subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, “XPDJOA” is written as “DPXAOJ” and “THBRUC” is written as “BHTCUR”. How will “GILDZM” be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

“XPDJOA” is written as “DPXAOJ”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/801f3406e59379029860b54ff530b44f7c3c6916d428b7e6975eea2f5e13ef5e.png] 

and

“THBRUC” is written as “BHTCUR”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca6786c63b752095c43a260070d2b53228d28b174cc22d07b6ad56a65c85dab.png] 

Similarly,

“GILDZM” will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dfb4767572697ef8591e2956aa70b758fc6cca1d79444843fb18a24863b5242.png] 

Hence, the correct answer **"LIGMZD".**
